content.comment_body: How can I set up a PT100 input? I can't locate a dedicated analog input block in the software, just a general AI block. I'm working with [product_name] [version_no]. I'd love to use an older automation system for my heating, but that's not possible.

Hello, if you'd like to connect a PT100 sensor to [company_name] [product_name], first ensure the hardware is configured properly. Use a model with analog input (0-10V, 4-20mA); versions like [product_name] [version_no] work well, or you can opt for a PT100-specific module, which is pricier. In the software ([product_name] [version_no]), design your project using the analog input block and other relevant analog blocks. Best regards.

I've already installed the PT100 input modules, but I’m unclear about which I/O block to use. I only see a basic I/O block. Is the PT100 input handled similarly to the others? If so, would the temperature inputs be assigned to ai3, ai4 since ai1/ai2 belong to the main unit ([version_no])? Where do I apply scaling?

To operate the PT100 with [company_name] [product_name], you need to use analog inputs (refer to pages 39 and 40 of the manual for wiring details). Using the analog input block is essential; if you use a digital input block, the signal will be treated digitally, which isn't correct (see section 4.1, page 116 of the manual). For scaling analog values, check section 4.3.6, page 135. Be sure to use only analog blocks for these signals. The referenced manual pages are from the Spanish manual [document]. Best regards.

Hello, from what you've described, you shouldn't have trouble with addressing or wiring. Assigning to AI3 is appropriate if you're using a DC version of [product_name] and one PT100 input module. The sensor type should be set within an analog function block, such as an amplifier. You can verify the input address using the online test feature or by viewing analog inputs directly on the display (navigate with the cursor until you see the AI inputs). Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure how to integrate a PT100 temperature sensor with [product_name] [version_no] software, particularly in terms of selecting the correct input blocks and configuring analog scaling. There is confusion about how the software manages PT100 inputs and how to assign and scale related analog addresses for the module. Documentation is frequently referenced, showing the need for manual consultation to achieve proper setup. While some technical clarifications are offered, the process lacks intuitive, step-by-step guidance within the software, presenting challenges for users without advanced experience. This reveals a user experience issue regarding the absence of integrated, clear instructions and mapping between hardware and software configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate an easy-to-follow configuration within the software for PT100 sensors, expecting dedicated analog sensor blocks and clear guidance on where and how to scale values.
